title: Sun & Moon
extract:
Not to be confused with the Alignment system.

Sun & Moon are the signature Dual Nikanas of Teshin. They are used by the Drifter in Duviri and can be manufactured for Warframe use.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Mountain's Edge stance.

Drifter Combat
Power Strike (blocking + heavy attack, default RMB  + MMB ) sends forth two arcs of explosive energy that deal  Electricity damage with guaranteed procs.（Only works on Duviri）
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High block angle (60°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average attack range (2.60 m)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.60 m)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.60 m)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average total damage (190)
Below average status chance (22.00%)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)

Very low status chance (10.00%)

See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The blueprint is rewarded on completion of The Duviri Paradox Quest. Additional copies can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for  100,000. 

Notes
Sun & Moon has an unique combo when no stance is equipped, which is not found in the  Mountain's Edge stance.
This combo consists of 4 attacks, with the first two being individual weapon strikes, and the second two being hits with both weapons.
The final hit in the combo applies a forced  Impact and  Slash status.

Trivia
Sun & Moon are heavily inspired by the Daishō (大小), a combination of Katana and Wakizashi exclusively wielded by Samurai warriors during feudal Japan.
If the player has no melee weapon equipped during the climactic battle of The War Within, the player's Warframe will automatically wield Sun; in this form it is identical to an unmodded Nikana and is dubbed the "Teshin Nikana."
Sun & Moon were first introduced in The New War, used by playable Teshin. However, he used the Dual Sword stances  Carving Mantis,  Crossing Snakes, and  Swirling Tiger instead of the unique Dual Nikana stance  Mountain's Edge. Sun & Moon also had the ability to change between  Cold,  Electricity, and  Heat elements.
Sun & Moon use the Nikana Dax Skin sheathe.
Prior to Update 23.0 (2018-06-15), Teshin's dual nikanas used the Ymir-Form Gemini Nikana Sheath.
